title: Full accessibility audit of delivered plans
context: The UDL checklist (task-005) and the schema validator (task-006) enforce structural accessibility requirements per plan. But those are self-checks and schema checks, not an independent accessibility audit. The PLAN.md success metrics require at least one full accessibility audit per milestone (metric #5). M3 requires a full audit of the delivered plan library — reviewing all plans against WCAG 2.1 / CAST UDL guidelines, checking that exported PDFs and HTML are screen-reader accessible, and identifying any systematic accessibility gaps across the library. The audit also validates that the UDL checklist (task-005) is catching the right things in practice.
objective: Conduct a full accessibility audit of all plans delivered by M3, evaluate them against WCAG 2.1 and CAST UDL guidelines, identify systematic gaps, and produce a committed audit report with remediation recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: All plans published and adopted by M3 are reviewed in the audit.

Audit evaluates both the Markdown/front-matter source and the exported PDF/HTML output against WCAG 2.1 Level AA criteria at minimum: text alternatives, adaptable structure, distinguishable content, keyboard accessibility (for HTML), readable and navigable.
Audit evaluates alignment with CAST UDL guidelines: representation, action/expression, engagement — checking that differentiation, language supports, and udlNotes are substantive (not boilerplate).

Audit report identifies: any plans with accessibility deficiencies (and what they are), any systematic gaps in the UDL checklist or schema enforcement that allowed deficiencies through, and recommendations for remediation.
Remediation tasks are spawned as new maintenance tasks for any plans with identified deficiencies.
Audit report is committed to the repo.
resources: teacher-lesson-plans-udl-005 — UDL + age-appropriateness checklists (what the audit validates)
teacher-lesson-plans-scale-018 — scale library (the plans to audit)
output: A committed full accessibility audit report covering all M3-delivered plans, evaluated against WCAG 2.1 and CAST UDL guidelines, with identified deficiencies and remediation recommendations.
